_doc: tools/ci/check_large_blobs.py 的白名单：已入库的历史大文件，重编/重烘后再次提交时不拦。
path 是相对仓库根的路径，允许 fnmatch 通配；max_mb 是该条目的单文件预算（缺省时用 --max-mb，即 5）。
每条必须有 why：白名单是给评审看的理由，不是静音开关。新文件默认走 5 MB 闸门。
本项目不使用 Git LFS。这里放行的都是「构建可重建但当前已入库」的产物或素材源，
新产物请走 GitHub Release asset / 网络盘，不要再加进来。

allow.why: Four era music suites as FMOD stem WAVs (30+ MB each); the source stems were authored for ElevenLabs/FMOD baking and are already in history, re-baking cannot shrink them.
Baked FMOD banks (Desktop/Mobile Music_*.bank, ~25 MB). Regenerated by Build-FMOD-Banks.cmd from Audio/ stems and committed so players do not need FMOD Studio.
Prebuilt dots_ext native extension for android/macos/web (~12-17 MB per artifact). Committed so a clone without a C++ toolchain still runs; rebuilt by gdext/rebuild.bat.
FmodGodot web side module; same rationale as the dots_ext binaries above.
CJK font sources (SweiGothic ~15 MB each) that the UI and pck fonts are subset from; subsetting is a build step, the source stays here.
Prebaked 1024px material textures (.res, 5.33 MB each), cloud-shadow noise and papercut atlases; see docs/build-from-source.md section 7.1 for the size budget discussion.
Military papercut/codex atlases (6-7 MB PNG) that pre-date this gate and ship in the pck.
The perf-validation mirror project vendors its own fonts and committed 12 MB perf.csv evidence runs; it is a separate checkout of the game, not part of the pck.
Historical terrain-material source PNGs (5-9 MB) that were committed under .codex-temp by an earlier agent; kept because terrain_materials/pack_tiles.py can still be re-run from them.
